name: Reitetsu na Toshi no Josei Kugusuguri Tsudzukeete Tachiba Gyakuten Suru Hanashi
original_name: 冷徹な年下の女性をくすぐり続けて立場逆転する話
source:
Our hero has taken up jujutsu, but there's a younger instructor there who shows him absolutely no respect despite his age.

When he's finally had enough, he captures her and decides to give her a ticklish lesson in respect...

but he doesn't count on the tables being turned...

A game where hard tickling is the main focus.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ225668.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
